domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record could be retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India sales splits were not accessible: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com both returned 'HTTP Error 403 Forbidden', priyagold.com failed with 'SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED', and web_search was unavailable ('searx: Connection refused') for all queries. Domestic turnover and India-market supply therefore recorded as null — not public in the sources reachable in this session.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and BOL numbers exist for Feb 2026 shipments to Yemen (Aden), UAE (Jebel Ali) and USA (New York), all under the Priyagold brand, HS 19053100/19059020 — consistent with the declared biscuit HS codes. Note the address on the customs record is 'D-1, SECTOR-2, DISTT: GAUTAM BUDH NAGAR' (Noida, Uttar Pradesh), which differs from the claimed state Madhya Pradesh; the claimed PAN AAACS3026P was not independently verified (registry pages blocked). Domestic (India) supply evidence: следов поставок по внутреннему рынку в доступных источниках не найдено — GST turnover, GeM/CPPP contracts and annual-report splits are all null because the sources were blocked, so domestic_status is 'unknown', not 'none_found'.
